Epilogue
A priest and a noble woman stand in a street of a strange town, both holding leashes to dogs they do not remember owning
Luminous clouds raining tears of jade appear over the hills outside the city
The dogs fight, the woman’s dog is torn to pieces but she is unbothered. The priest offers his leash and she takes it
The priest’s dog collapses at his feet
Edgewalker, a hooded figure, and Shadowthrone with his five Hounds of Shadow appear
The hooded figure summoned Edgewalker ‘to mitigate’
Shadowthrone wonders wtf is this place, the hooded one guesses a timeless necropolis of discarded people
A carriage appears from down the street, the woman claims her ride is here

(Night of Knives) An event occurs in Malaz City where every realm and warren are cracked open. Edgewalker talks to a trapped former ruler of Shadow, helps Kiska seek refuge away from Hounds of Shadow, rescues Temper from a snake woman. When Temper fought against Jhenna, a Jaghut guardian of Deadhouse that ployed to escape her position, Edgewalker announced her failure. When Kellanved and Dancer reached the Deadhouse, Edgewalker welcomed them as new Lords of House Shadow, excited for the change they bring.

(Bonehunters) Edgewalker was present when Cotillion spoke with three chained eleint: Kalse, Eloth, and Ampelas. Edgewalker was impressed by his knowledge and conversation with the dragons, who were failed claimants of the Throne of Shadow. Edgewalker considers himself an elemental force, an Elder God, and would consider offering aid against the Crippled God. Telorast and Curdle are his agents, and has some curiosity about Apsalar.

(Reaper’s Gale) Kilmandaros killed dragons and tried to save Kurald Emurlahn from shattering. Rake offered his help, because Edgewalker was committed elsewhere. Kilmandaros accepts his help to expel pretenders and keep the Throne of Shadow unoccupied.
Ditch, a thuggish looking wizard of Pale that betrayed Anomander Rake

[Note: During the Siege of Pale at the beginning of Gardens of the Moon, the wizards fled as soon as the Claw infiltrated the city even though Anomander Rake immediately took care of them. Pale would have won against the Malazan Empire if the wizards had stayed. Baruk surrendered the mages in Darujhistan to Rake for punishment.]
Inside Dragnipur, the floor was muddy with oil sick stones. The air was damp, a layer of grimy film on peoples’ skin
Chained to the wagon within Dragnipur, pulling it away from pursuing Chaos
He would have new neighbors that appear in blurred swirls, people slain by Rake’s sword
The latest is the demon prince Pearl, who carried additional bodies because the wagon itself is full
Pearl leaves to find answers, a bear-like beast takes his place
Ditch recalls calling out in search of answers when he first arrived, Draconus was one of the first to answer him
Apsal’ara, the Lady of Thieves, was slain by Dragnipur when she was sneaking through Moon’s Spawn
She was known for stealing the moon and stealing fire
She snuck behind one of the wagon’s wheels and onto a shelf of the front axle as rotted flesh rained through the floorboards of the wagon
She worked one length of chain against each other, hoping they would saw against one another until the friction melts and separates them
She had witnessed Paran free the two Hounds of Shadow [Note: Doan and Ganrod]
She tried to follow behind them but was denied by the portal’s cold, more intense cold than Omtose Phellack
In a Teblor Uryd village, a mangled dog had chosen to settle here
The dog had bitterness and sorrow in its eyes
The Uryd elders declared the dog “god touched” and thus was fed and left alone
One day the dog traveled southward towards the Nathii lands below
Two girls a year before adulthood picked up weapons and followed after the dog
The girls were fearless and resolute, traits from a father they never met
The girls’ mothers, a mother and a daughter, were informed. The daughter cried, the mother did not
Kruppe sits by a hearth fire twirling his ratty thin hair beard
An Elder God sits opposite from him, claiming he is not involved in the war. The god notices Kruppe is sad and asks if he wants to talk about it
Kruppe declines
A grey haired stranger joins them, and sings with Kruppe a song heard in K’rul’s Bar
“Oh fail city, where strangers arrive…
“… pushing into cracks, there to abide”
Kruppe is the master of spies in Darujhistan, the Eel. Also a regular of the Phoenix Inn
Divination powers through his dreams, instead of the Deck of Dragons or casting knuckles
When a guild assassin was killed by Tiste Andii on K’rul’s Belfry, the god K’rul appears in Kruppe’s dreams
Kruppe was an informant to High Alchemist Baruk, telling him about the internal wars in the Assassin’s Guild, and giving him a wax copy of Oponn’s coin without saying Crokus has it
K’rul used Kruppe’s dream (immune to young gods) to help Tattersail who shifted into Nightchill’s body shift again into the Mhybe’s pregnant womb
Kruppe leaves Baruk’s Estate, walking past the Bridgeburners impersonating construction workers to bury munitions underneath the street
Whiskeyjack sends Sorry to follow Kruppe to the Phoenix Inn
Baruk sends Kruppe and the Phoenix Inn regulars to investigate foreign parties in the Gadrobi Hills, in his dreams K’rul further explains Elder magic brews in the hills
Adjunct Lorn and Tool attack Kruppe’s group to stop them from following so they can release Raest
Kruppe provides masks for himself, Rallick, and Murillio for Lady Simtal’s Gedderone’s Eve Fete, Murillo suspects Kruppe of being the Eel and Kruppe wipes his memories
Kruppe falls asleep at the Fete, confronts Raest in his Elder vision dream along with Tool and K’rul
Raest senses Imass in Kruppe, yet unable to kill him
The forces of the Dujek Onearm, Caladan Brood, and Anomander Rake form an alliance against the Pannion Domin
Darujhistan’s council sends Murillio, Coll, and Estraysian D’Arle as their emissaries.
Kruppe invites himself and Caladan wants him to stay because she was present in Kruppe’s dreams
Kruppe says individual council members are pursuing personal interests with internal politicking and backdoor deals, suggests a Trygalle Trade Guild contract
In the Mhybe’s dreams, Kruppe gifts her ancient Rhivi copper ornaments to sooth her pain and aches
During another tense war alliance meeting when Silverfox refused to have her T’lan Imass fight against the Crippled God, Kruppe rambles about standing in the Crippled God’s path
Caladan Brood gets pissed that Kruppe doesn’t elaborate and slams Burn’s Hammer at his feet, splitting bedrock and causing a new mountain range to rise
Kruppe stands on an island surrounded by fissures filling with blood, showing how Burn was being poisoned
Kruppe’s efficacy is now known. Helped Silverfox come into existence: Malazan souls (Tattersail) in a Rhivi woman’s body that would one day lead the T’lan Imass
Kruppe convinces Silverfox to attend the Second Gathering and explain the T’lan Imass have already won against the Jaghut and now wish for oblivion. Silverfox’s purpose is to end the T’lan Imass
Kruppe flirts with Hetan, they have a short sexual affair. Hetan can’t keep up and she becomes pregnant
Kruppe helps Silverfox and K’rul create a dreamscape for the Mhybe where she can be young and also help the T’lan Imass’ souls recover
Book One:
Vow to the Sun
Challice D’Arle, now Lady Vidikas, watches from her balcony as the people of Darujhistan celebrate the first night of the Gedderone Fete, new year’s celebration
Earlier in the evening, she attended celebrations with her husband Gorlas Vidikas who became a new member of the city council
Gorlas wears a gold torc with a sapphire gem, awarded to those who performed a great service to Darujhustan
In reality, Gorlas hates the nobility, hiding his growing disdain every time a noble congratulates him
Challice stands on the balcony, not sharing in the happiness of the people below her, reminiscing how she was happier in the past
(Picker)
Picker went on a grocery run on the first night of new year’s celebration and is heading back to K’rul’s Bar
She went to pick up Rhivi flatbread for Blend who sprained her ankle, while Antsy and Bluepearl went to pick up Saltoan wine
Mallet’s been depressed since retirement
(Dester Thrin)
Dester Thrin, a member of the Darujhistan Assassin’s Guild, has been watching K’rul’s Bar for four nights and is stalking a “big arsed woman” [Picker] that left through the back door
His targets are ex-soldiers
Dester thinks back to the succession wars after Vorcan disappeared
Seba Krafar became the new Guild leader
In the past, Rallick Nom proved in a legendary battle that poison can defeat magic
The battle popularized poison (Moranth tralb) as a weapon, Rallick Nom has cult followings within the Guild
Seba Krafar has killed five cult leaders, though the cult is still suspected to exist
Chillbais is a badger-sized winged demon that’s been perched on a corner post for months without moving
Behind him is a garden with a fountain, in front of him is an Azath House
Chillbais watches as a figure escape the Azath House, dodges the roots trying to ensnare him, and jumps over the garden wall
Chillbais tries to fly, falls onto the ground, and then launches into the air to avoid the Azath House’s roots. He flies to tell his master
Zechan Throw and Giddyn the Quick plan to ambush two targets [Antsy and Bluepearl] by hiding in recessed doorways of a narrow street
(Dester Thrin)
Dester Thrin rushes forward gets four steps close
Picker slashes his neck open with her longsword
Dester bleeds out on the floor and dies, his daggers falling on the ground
(Picker)
Picker expects some thieves while walking through the streets, was easy for her to see a Daru in a crowd of Gadrobi following her
Picker sees his daggers and worries he wasn’t just a thug or a cutpurse
(Zechan Throw)
Zechan Throw stabs through [Antsy’s] chest while Giddyn stabs [Bluepearl]
Bluepearl falls to his knees, vomits, and his wine jug breaks on the floor
However, Zechan dies when he gets stabbed in the neck by a shortsword
Someone grabs Giddyn by the mouth and his lungs are magically filled with water, he dies drowning
(Antsy)
Bluepearl conjured illusions [with Mockra] that walked 10 paces ahead of them to bait their assassins
Antsy had seen their assassins halfway down the street and feels they’re being targeted
Picker sees someone suspicious across the street from the bar, kicks him in the balls, and smacks his head down so his skull fractures on the cobbled floor
The man twitches until he stops moving
A drunk bystander said he deserved it, asks to marry Picker, her first decent marriage proposal in 20 years
Antsy and Bluepearl join her by the door and they walk inside together
Blend’s sitting by the door sticking her leg out to trip any suspected intruders
Picker kicks her leg out the way and throws the flatbread on her lap
Picker calls got a meeting in the office
Tells Blend to go get Mallet, bad luck with Spindle on his pilgrimage, and also get Duiker
K’rul’s Bar has a small crowd of regulars too drunk to leave past midnight and a bard in the corner singing obscure verses of Anomandaris
Challice returns from the balcony into the parlor room with the three duelists and newest members of Darujhistan’s council
Gorlas Vidikas, sitting in his chair sipping wine
Shardan Lim, a man who doesn’t hide how much he desires her. Her husband doesn’t seem to care
Tallest, skinniest of the three men. Dry skin, washed out blue eyes, lipless mouth. His left arm is scarred and twice as big as his right arm
Hanut Orr, charming and arrogant man that seduces half of the city’s noble women
Challice goes back to her room and has her handmaiden lay out all her old jewelry on her vanity desk
Challice used to love getting gifts from her suitors, now the sight of the cheap and gaudy baubles made her nauseous
Challice wants to sell them the next day
