Kedeviss thinks about how Andarist was more of a father to Nimander, but Nimander was becoming more and more like Rake

cards.h: Scene 6 (South of God’s Walk Mountains, Clip)

i.html: About a mile upslope and away from the village, Clip watched Nimander’s kin go in and out of the huts below
Clip claims he faced the Dying God only because he was concerned for Nimander’s group, believes that they are deluded in thinking they saved him
Clip ponders and wants to lead the Tiste Andii out of wasting their lives and deliver justice against everything that did them wrong
The world, the gods, and even Anomander Rake who abandoned them at Andara and Drift Avalii
Shares belief with the Tiste Liosan’s view of pure justice, excuses revealed the cowardice in criminals
Believes pity and mercy is a flaw, criminals will use compassion to evade punishment they deserve
High Priestess of Dark and other Temple sisters feast on seafood boil
High Priestess notes the fishing boats hauled an unexpected bounty in the Kurald Galain waters
[Note: Endest and his new fishing vendor]
The temple guardian walks to High Priests, the woman in scale mail and ringed leather and lowered her grille face-plate to conceal her mouth as she whispers a message
High Priestess has Second and Third sisters stay, calls out the Sixth sister for secretly drinking alcohol from a flask and has her serve the rest as they wait outside in the Unlit Garden
An obese witch arrives to ask for them to help Salind
Talks about saemankelyk’s corruption of the Redeemer cult, warns that it could spread
Affirms saeman means Dying God and kelyk means blood, both words from a dialect south of God’s Walk Mountains
The witch wouldn’t gone to Spinnock but can’t find him
[Note: This is the same priestess in Black Coral that Spinnock went to in chapter 4 when he wanted to help Seerdomin, but she said the Redeemer does not kneel to Rake]
High Priestess leads the witch downstairs to an octagonal chamber with onyx tesserae floors
As the witch steps into the chamber, the cleansing darkness of Kurald Galain has eased her aches, breathing, and will cure her of other ailments over a few days
The witch admits she knows that the Tiste Andii wouldn’t have infected them, but needed something to bargain with
The witch planned to succumb to her illness, hoping her sacrifice giving more reason to help her friend Salind
High Priestess says it is a flaw of humans that everything needs to be an exchange when they should simply ask for help
Recalls in the past that a Rhivi man and someone pretending to be Prince K’azz D’avore tried to bargain and buy an alliance with the Tiste Andii
Rake simply said to tell them about their situation and ask. They do not negotiate
The witch asks for help, High Priestess says no
The temple assesses that neither Salind nor the Redeemer need help just yet
The priestesses will act if only to act first before Silanah decides to raze the camp destroying everything
The witch doesn’t know who Silanah is, High Priestess affirms eleint means dragon
They return upstairs for tea
Karsa comes back after three days when he left to meet the Hounds of Shadow
Karsa and Samar have cute small talk
Samar misses being clean, but got dirty all because she needed to return his horse
Karsa says she wanted to see him, stop arguing with herself and sleep with him
‘You’d be gentle as a desert bear, of course. I’d probably never recover’
‘There are sides of me, witch, that you have not seen, yet’
Samar misses the comforts of her civilized home
Karsa breaks down point by point how the comforts come at the cost of other’s suffering
Indentured workers sacrificing their body and health to manufacture goods
Children and lepers chased out of communities
Water taken from farms, plants and animals die
An undead dragon lands and veers into a Tiste Edur, introduces himself as Tulas Shorn
Neither Karsa nor Traveller were scared, so Samar gave up panicking
Tulas Shorn is tall, gaunt, androgynous, long filthy hair. Wears a chain hauberk, empty sheathe, hide leggings, knee high leather boots

Tulas greets Samar first in her native Ugari language, calls her a Priestess of Burn because she’s able to commune with spirits and the land. She does not use warrens or alien power, she uses earth, sky, water, and stone
Burn dreams of Samar often, Tulas knows because there is ‘death in dreaming’
Karsa does not like him as a Tiste Edur, Traveller does not like him assuming he belongs to Hood
Tulas feels unwelcomed, Samar is exasperated and welcomes him as a guest at her campfire
Traveller apologizes, Karsa says he’s killed enough Edur making Tulas nervous
Tulas explains he escaped death only by opportunity [Note: Trygalle Trade Guild]. Didn’t know what he’ll do next, wonders of Burn can dream him to be alive
Tulas talks about Burn being poisoned by the Crippled God

It is an extraordinary act of courage to come to know a stranger’s pain. To even consider such a thing demands a profound dispensation, a willingness to wear someone else’s chains, to taste their suffering, to see with one’s own eyes the hue cast on all things - the terrible stain that is despair
No one speaks anymore, the campfire burns out and everyone sleeps. In the morning Tulas and all the horses besides Havok are gone
Samar apologizes expecting to hear that it’s her fault

Karsa responds, ‘Witch, goodwill is not something that needs an apology. You were betrayed. Your trust was abused. If there are strangers who thrive on such things, they will ever remain strangers - because they have no other choice. Pity Tulas shorn and those like it. Even death taught it nothing.’
Karsa rides out looking for other horses for the both of them, remarks that maybe Tulas scared the horses off
Samar initially thinks Karsa was trying to spare her feelings, but realized it was more to give Tulas Shorn the benefit of the doubt. A way to forgive him and let go
Traveller and Samar leave the two saddles behind
Tulas had dropped the horses off in similar looking herds to the south
Tulas pitied all the animals that suffered and died in the wars he’s seen
Tulas was mocked among the Edur for having strong compassion for animals
While flying, Tulas tasted something in the air that would’ve made his heart thump
Tulas wonders of the Hounds of Shadow that he raised will remember him
Gruntle is on the roof as the horses pull the Trygalle carriage through stormy seas
Gruntle had nothing left in his stomach after everything up and lost his helmet
Faint grabs his hair and looks at him, laughing at him for looking so pale. The TTG has done worse and she’s having fun
Gruntle pushes her forehead away and she leaves
Gruntle thinks how pathetic it would be that he might actually die here and not in battle
The rest of the crew screams as they head towards a cliff a mile away
Gruntle looks back to see a mountain high wave behind the carriage
Gruntle shuts his eyes as the wave picks them up and brings them above the clouds
Everyone thinks Reccanto Ilk is the blind one, they don’t realize Glanno Tarp the carriage driver is also practically blind
Glanno sees a tower
As the waves hit the top of the cliff, carriage is fully submerged in the water as it lands and the horses pull onto a street
The grease on the wheels washed away, without lubricant the axles break and the carriage skids on the floor and stops at the front of a tavern
The driver bench breaks off, the horses pull the bench and hops over a low walk into a corral
The bench shatters against the wall, Glanno Tarp’s legs are broken but cushioned against the wall by horse poop
The tavern patrons walk outside to see what happened
The shareholders fall from the roof onto the floor then get up to walk inside
The carriage door opens up, water flows out, and the rest go inside
A very tall, blue skinned man with tusks shaped like ram horns looks out from the tallest floor of the tower
A dozen non-human servants look at the tusked man as he says “Not again”
The servants wail in a chorus, the noise reaching down to three women lying on stone crypts and also started shrieking
The tusked man cringes from the shrieking
In the tavern called the Reach of Woe, the shareholders sit down at tables
Amby and Bole realize everyone left to the cellars below
Gruntle and Mappo make eye contact, realizing something’s coming that’s not a storm
Musings on evil, that the sad truth is that evil is having indifference, lack of mercy, and giving up be moral
Murillio walks with an extreme expression on his face
Bellam Nom is scared to call out to his teacher, decides to follow him
Snell thinks his parents are pathetic, falling apart after Harllo disappeared
Bedek and Myrla joined the church of the Crippled God, hoping to ask the prophet what happened to Harllo
The prophet was a man paralyzed from the neck down, half his face paralyzed, eye like a rotten crab apple
As the prophet was carried by his diseased followers, he describes the end of the world, only the sick and stupid would survive
Myrla pulled the cart carrying her crippled husband
Snell pressed on Hinty’s chest to make her pass out and stop her crying, plans to sell both Hinty and Mew for money to use when he runs away
Bellam Nom is upset the quality of the dueling school declined
Knew that Stonny is broken, and Murillio is also broken because he was in love with her
Bellam would eavesdrop on conversations and can read lips
Bellam continues following behind Murillio
Seba Krafar meets with Humble Measure to discuss assassination contracts
Seba doesn’t like Humble, but he’s offered the most money he’s ever seen, though not as much as what the Malazan Empire offered Vorcan
Humble wants Seba to prioritize a new contract to kill a councilman and everything alive in their estate
Seba is open about the decline of the Assassin’s Guild
Shortage of quality assassins, out of necessity many were promoted to fill positions they lacked months of experience for
The last attack on K’rul’s Bar killed the last batch of promotions, the failure damaged the assassins confidence
Seba offered other methods to obtain a council seat, Humble remains firm to keep his motivations private for wanting to obtain it through murder
Seba and Humble agree to give the Assassin’s Guild ten days to prepare
Coll is approached by Hanut Orr who rejects the expansion of the Malazan embassy
Coll warns Hanut against politicking outside the council chambers
Can assume that Hanut is offering a bribe or accusing Coll of taking bribes
Coll would request a censure to thoroughly audit both himself and Hanut, enough to scare Hanut away
Estraysian D’Arle leads Coll into a private alcove specifically for politicking outside council chambers
The old councilmen have placed the troublesome trio (Hanut Orr, Shardan Lim, Gorlas Vidikas) on useless committees to waste their time
Coll believes over time they’ll be dangerous
Outside the council building, Hanut and Shardan argue
Hanut disrespects Gorlas’s wife, Gorlas simply smiles and appreciates his wordplay
Shardan doesn’t believe Humble Measure will get a council seat, there isn’t one open
Gorlas retorts his perversion has made him wealthy and he just bought a new property in Darujhistan
(Seba Krafar)
Seba Krafar walks through the streets to a cellar that used to hold coal before the city used its gas reserves
Seba’s arrogance in his intimidating size made him careless, didn’t detect someone following him in the cellar
The tracker grabs Seba’s neck and holds him up off the floor and holds a knife under Seba’s eye
The tracker leaves a sack of five councils to buy off the Malazan contract
Seba offers to take out Humble Measure along with 5 councils, the man rejects
As a courtesy the man tells Seba to hold himself by a lantern until sensation comes bank to his legs
Seba realizes he shit himself and is grateful not to fall on his ass
(Fisher kel Tarth)
Fisher is satisfied paying off Seba Krafar
Believes he has time to deal with Humble Measure
Narrator Kruppe notes this will be a grievous mistake
On the way back to K’rul’s Bar to check on Picker, Fisher might be able to help retrieve her lost soul
[Gaz] killed someone in the alley two days ago
Iskaral appears to deliver a message to Fisher from Shadowthrone, seek out the Eel
Bedek is on a cart pulled by Myrla to the exterior of the Temple of Chains
Mobs of people wait outside for the prophet, the doors are closed, days at a time
Alcoholics, pock-scarred, the crippled, the blind with milky eyes
The prophet helped people by killing them and delivering their souls to the Crippled God
Bedek snaps out of it and doesn’t think they belong here
Bedek wants to find Harllo, not beseech a god to make him feel whole
Myrla, however, no longer wants to find Harllo and is the same as everyone else in the mob
(Snell)
Snell suffocates both his little sisters Hinty and Mew until they pass out
Snell’s trying to figure out how to carry them in a sling and sell them to a human trafficker in the Daru High Market for 10-20 councils
Murillio comes in, sees everything, and picks Snell up to his eye level
Snell is frightened and thinks honesty is the better choice for himself
Murillio puts together that Snell never helped the family and the night Harllo disappeared came home with the dried dung that Harllo regularly collected
Bellam Nom appears at the door and promises to watch over Snell, Hinty, and Mew to make sure Snell confesses everything to his parents when they come home
Snell threatens him with his street friends, Bellam promises they’ll cut Snell off when they hear Bellam Nom’s name
(Bellam Nom)
Bellam Nom is clever and mentally tortures Snell with the possibilities of what could happen, but doesn’t do anything physical that leaves bruises
Bullies learn nothing even bullied
They are shown the same fear they’ve lived their lives in
Change happens on the outside, not the inside
Challice used the kitchen delivery path as her secret route for her adultery. Moths lined the path
Gorlas waits on the path to see her before he leaves for his trip to the mines that takes 3 days
Gorlas grabs her right breast and expects details on the man he doesn’t know whom Challice has been seeing
Challice feels trapped and carefully calculates her next response that would most please him
‘All right’ would make her feel cornered, give him immediate gratification that would morph into vengeance when he comes back
‘If you like’ was too defiant and indifferent
Challice chose to say ‘Until then, husband’. Gorlas eyes dilated with arousal, Challice feels like she chose the correct response
Murillio rents a horse for 3 councils with a 20 council deposit
The horse was so old, worn down, and miserable that Murillio considered leaving the horse with a nice farmer, abandoning the deposit
Past the leper colony outside the city gates, Murillio approaches the same shepherd that sold Harllo
The shepherd says he found him near dead, helped the boy, and sold him to the Eldra Iron Mongers to the west
Murillio speeds off with the horse
A man leads an ox hauling a cart of braided leather
A traveler pays the man to ride in the back
The cart passes by an ornate, lacquered, leaf-sprung carriage [Gorlas’]
Snell is forced to play with his sisters and as soon as the yarn ball goes near the door, Snell runs out and escapes outside
Round through Twisty Alley, through a sewage pipe, and into Purse Street
Snell has grand delusions if being a gang leader, get wealthy, hire assassins to kill Murillio and Stonny, buy his parents debt to make them pay him, pimp his sisters, and become king of the city
Bellam locked the sisters up safely, catches up to Snell and trips him
Bellam threatens to kill Snell, for the first time Snell feels like he’s met a bigger monster than he is and is completely frightened of Bellam, sweats and pisses himself
Bellam drags Snell into his uncle Goruss’ shop, the person Snell thinks is the human trafficker he was going to find
Bellam pretends to sell Snell, uncle Goruss drags him downstairs into a dark cellar and locks him in an iron cage
Goruss says a night is enough to scare Snell without breaking his mind, usually deals with kids over 15 years old
The hopeless kids get sent to rowing benches, but are also paid and fed, for five years. Enough to make them behave
Barathol has some success, the new Malazan embassy garrison created a fashion demand among Darujhistan’s nobles for imperial longswords
The local smiths are still trying to figure out how they’re made
The rough solidity is achieved by Untan foundries that don’t burn very hot, and red iron that’s almost exclusively found in the Untan Hills
Scillara enjoys hearing him talk, came to flirt with Barathol
Barathol doesn’t want to be another heartbroken man in Scillara’s wake
Barathol admits he would’ve beaten Crokus for breaking her heart, thought he had no chance with Scillara
Barathol and Scillara nearly hug, but the Darujhistan City Guard and a Guild representative comes to shut down the smithy and arrest Barathol and Chaur
Cites bogus violations like disposing waste in the common drain instead of the industrial drain, and having an apprentice which is only allowed for guild members
Barathol agrees to be taken away, begs to no grab Chaur and gently handle him
Scillara pulls on the Guild representative’s braid
In Chaur’s mind, the world was composed of three objects
Objects that moved
Objects that never moved
Objects that are still but can be moved
Love is a deeply rooted object that Chaur can go to when he looked
Hate, also a deeply rooted object like love
Only sees in one direction to the outside world, never inward at Chaur
Hate knew everything, could use Chaur’s body, and loves blood
The City Guards let their guard down thinking Chaur was relaxed, unaware of his situation
Chaur, smiling all the while, suddenly punches all of the guards knocking them away
Grabs a guard by the neck and belt and tries him at a stone wall
Grabs an amphora from a market stall and shatters it against the officer
Roundhouse punches the last guard’s head
Barathol is stunned
Gorlas arrives at the mines
The sickly foreman is concerned about the interest payments on Gorlas’ loan to him
Gorlas is callous and willing to have him evicted and suggests to live in a shack at the mines
Gorlas then flips and says he’ll cancel the payments so the foreman can fit comfortably, if only to manipulate the foreman
The foreman reports
3 moles have died, average. One in a cave collapse, two by greyface sickness
A new vein if red iron is discovered, twice the price at half weight than iron
Gorlas is aware only one smith at the moment can meet the demand for the Malazan longswords
The foreman has heard rumors that red iron can cheaply be made from iron
Gorlas considers a partnership with the smith but decides it’s too messy to deal with
A trader cart with the ox approaches
Murillio has blisters on his feet from wearing old riding shoes he hasn’t used in a long time
Murillio approaches the foreman to ask for Harllo and purchase his freedom and return him to his parents
Gorlas recognizes Murillio and accuses him of conspiring in Turban Orr’s public assassination, Ravyd Lim, and Lady Simtal’s suicide
Gorlas presses Murillio into a duel, if only to have Hanut in his debt and simply wound Murillio
The foreman leaves to get the laborers as their audience
Left alone, Murillio says Turban Orr didn’t deserve an honorable death
Murillio reveals all of the common folk know Challice Vidikas sleeps around, now he sees it’s because Gorlas is not much of a man
Gorlas becomes pale and gets actually pissed off
Krute of Talient comes home and sees Rallick facing a closed window, thinks he’s lost his mind
Krute was invited to Seba’s new contract to shake up the precious bloods
Krute’s pride is hurt living off Rallick’s money, frustrated that Rallick has no plans to replace Seba and keeps too many secrets
Krute declines Rallick’s offer to buy his retirement and they part ways
Rallick leaves for the first time since Crokus almost killed him
Rallick remains invisible, no one has come after him. Means no one at the Phoenix Inn nor Torvald gave him up
Rallick is baffled and a little hurt Torvald tries so hard to avoid him
Rallick heads to the Phoenix Inn, ready to make his move against Seba Krafar
Barathol leads a crying Chaur through crowds until three guards chase after them
Barathol tells Chaur to go to Lady Spite’s ship where she can protect him
Another six guards appeared and overwhelms Barathol
Barathol is arrested and sent to jail
Kruppe muses to Crokus trying to warn him
Humans can be aware of their flaws but do nothing about them until it’s too late
Can’t inside a world where crimes are punished and justice is incorruptible by money and power
Our survival trait of evasion may be the end of us
Crokus is confused, Kruppe attempts but fails to be more concise about trying to have Crokus avoid making bad decisions
Crokus wonders if Challice can really be with an assassin. Crokus leaves to go for a walk
The Prophet of the Crippled God is carried by four bearers
Almost passes Myrla but the Prophet presses four fingers on her forehead
Myrla says her son has been kidnapped
The prophet says their son [Snell] is beyond salvation. He chooses not compassion, uses love as a weapon, believes the future does not wait, he will devour everything around him.
Even the Crippled God must reject such a creature
The Prophet blesses Bedek and Myrla by name, their daughters are worse versions of them
Myrla’s forehead have dead nerves with spreading gangrene where the fingers touched
The mob tramples on Bedek and Myrla
Bedek’s throat is crushed and suffocates to death
Myrla’s hip is crushed and dies as she pulls her broken body over Bedek
Murillio throws his coin purse to the foreman
Gorlas speaks for the foreman, will not release Harllo so he can do what he pleases with him
Murillio and Gorlas duel
Gorlas matches Murillio’s old school dueling stance
Gorlas taps Murillio’s blade, then playfully jabs at the quillons. Murillio would be open if he tried to trap Gorlas with the quillons, so he doesn’t
Gorlas steps forward, Murillio steps back and pops the blisters on his foot
Gorlas rhythmically feints, then explosively lunges. Murillio cuts Gorlas sleeve
Gorlas lunges a second time and pierces Murillio’s left shoulder
Murillio tries to end the duel with just the wound as agreed before
However his last insult went too far. Gorlas pretends the agreement never happened with the foreman as witness
The duel resumes
Murillio lunges forward, Gorlas steps back awkwardly parrying and riposting
Murillio parries and attempts his finishing blow
Gorlas steps close to dodge and stabs Murillio’s throat and slashes it open
Murillio’s falls to the ground, apologizes to Harllo, darkness takes him, momentarily wakes from a kick to his face
Murillio dies ☠
(Gorlas)
Gorlas orders for the ox carter to take Murillio’s corpse back to Darujhistan, to retrieve Harllo and they can be rough with him, and to get the coinpurse
Gorlas is surprised how much money it was, a years’ wages for the foreman
(The Ox)
The ox pulls the cart with Murillio’s corpse back to Darujhistan
The Hounds travel in a crescent formation
Lock the white Hound would walk with its tongue lolling, sometimes by Shan’s side to Shan’s annoyance
Great Ravens fly above
Musings on the existence of Light, Dark, and Shadow
Pallid and Lock are the light on the Deragoth that give them shape and cast shadows
Cotillion looks at Shadowthrone and wonders what it’s like him to be the eye of a storm, what happens when the eye blinks
Shadowthrone cringes at needing to use Iskaral Pust again, Sordiko Qualm is not insurance enough
Tulas Shorn approaches from behind them
Cotillion knew their name by his research, but never found out Tulas’ gender
Cotillion wonders about the origin of the Deragoth, only seven more exist and the First Emperor [Dessimbelackis] chose them to be repositories for his soul
Also wonders about the Hounds of Shadow and Light
Shadowthrone continues to insist there albino, they were summoned by his need. Cotillion teases Shadowthrone also said he needed a Queen of Shadow
Tulas arrives and sees that the Hounds found new pets, annoying Shadowthrone
The Hounds surround Tulas but do not come when he beckons
Tulas notices two are missing, Anomander Rake killed Doan and Ganrod

[Note: Paran released them into Kurald Galain. They destroyed a Trygalle Trade carriage and reunited with their Deragoth counterparts, statues in the Nascent. At the Battle of Raraku, Karsa killed the two Deragoth summoned by a shaman]
Tulas was a ruler of Shadow, can’t believe the Hounds continue to follow them after two were killed
Tulas freaks out after seeing the white hounds, Pallid and Lock
Believes those that tried to tame the Hounds are destroyed
Beyond Light, Dark, and Shadow there are Hounds of Life, Fire, Stone, Wind, and Death
Tulas panics, veers in a dragon, and flies off frantically past the Great Ravens
The Hounds chase after him
Shadowthrone isn’t sure if they’re in trouble because he “blinked”
Kallor continues walking, thinks about how he’s starting to hate himself, more than any of his subjects hated him as king
Believes the people hated him because he shows the “perfection of success”, and it mocks their failures
Husbands who can’t make their wives happy so they beat them, teenage bullies, the wealthy walking past the poor
Kallor starts having flashback
His wife who cut her wrists to kill herself. Kallor believes she had nothing to live for when she already has everything, how she felt nothing and did extreme things to feel something again
His horse Valderon, dying from a lance in the chest. War fought between humans, dogs, Jheck, Tartheno Toblakai, and Forkrul Assail. Kallor damns himself for not feeling anything
‘I am humankind… Impervious to lessons. Pitiful in loss and defeat, vengeful in victory’

cards.h: Scene 3 (Ruins near God’s Walk Mountains, Nimander)

i.html: Nimander’s kin rests around a campfire, Clip is elsewhere
Skintick makes a figure out of sticks and he mocks and bickers with Nenanda
Nimander notes the entire mountainside seems to be a giant pile of fossils. Every stone in the drain channel has stones with bone, wood, teeth, or tusk
Kedeviss pulls her cloak tight and walks into the dark
Wolves are heard howling
A bear that was a former god of war approaches Samar Dev
Samar Dev voices Imass words that come to her, ‘De nek okral’
Traveller translates it to meaning short nose plains bear
The bear withdraws
Discussion of gods of war
Fener (boar), Togg & Fanderay (wolves of winter), Treach (tiger), de nek okral (bear)
Note that Fener has fallen, the old gods may be coming back for the spoils
Traveller explains they vanished when everything they hunted was taken from them
Karsa says there’s too many faces of war, Samar fears Karsa will sit in the last throne and rule a world no better than the one he destroyed
Karsa explains what he wants and believes
Thinks his own Teblor people were clumsier versions of civilization. Love of waste, reap the benefits of everything they perceived to own, to prove own they must destroy it
Progress is the passage of reality and time

‘I shall destroy what I can, but never shall I claim to own what I destroy. I will be the embodiment of progress, but emptied of greed. I shall be like nature’s first: blind. And I shall prove that ownership is a lie. The land, the seas, the life to be found there. The mountains, the plains, the cities, the farms. Water, air. We own none of it. This is what I will prove, and by proving will make it so’
A chained enkaral, large scale flying beast, bites into Pearl’s, the demon with a child like voice, neck to rip out his spine
The enkaral is held back by its chains, Pearl crushes its neck and opens it jaw
Draconus checks on Pearl, they have a cordial conversation
‘I think I will welcome an end - is that a terrible thing for me to say?’
The man [Draconus] shook his head, hoods expression hinting that he might be in pain. ‘No, my friend, it is not’
Chaos is now visible, legions of armed and armored humanoid shapes flowing, not marching, about a mile away
Draconus suggests it is a manifestation of what exists in everyone: a secret love of destruction
Pearl suggests when one dies, the evil within is torn free and goes to the realm of Chaos
(Ditch)
Ditch’s only freedom is to dream
In his dreams, he tries to act like a god looking at humanity like children and teach them consequences, while reminding himself that there was also joy and wonder too
Possible that Ditch’s dreams were not his own, but dreams of gods or tyrants
(Kadaspala)
Kadaspala is insane
Can sense the rage within Ditch’s dreams
Codes law into the sigils he tattoos on the bodies to give birth to a god that dreams of justice
Seerdomin is sexually allured by Salind’s form, on her knees, head hanging, and her body rhythmically moving
Seerdomin will still fight Salind
Itkovian asks why, Seerdomin says he can’t afford to because his enemy is self-righteous and has no doubt
Monkrat walked through the trashed pilgrim camp, seeing abandoned children, unable to offer them anything
Gradithan had been lost to kelyk, repeated words about the coming of the Dying God, the death and rebirth of all things
Monkrat left Gradithan
Hates fanaticism because it’s essentially ignorance is bliss, chasing a vast reward after giving up critical thought
Monkrat misses his hometown, Malaz City
Monkrat was a Bridgeburner, recorded to have died at Blackdog Wood in 1159
Anomander enters the High Priestess’s small office and they have cute banter
Rake sits in the less decorative of two chairs, stares at her desk judging it too small for her. Says she’s his favorite priestess
High Priestess notes aloud that he’s been staring at the desk instead of her
When he looks at her, she realizes it was a mercy
Rake wants to talk about Endest Silann, how he lost his faith and self confidence long ago
Endest’s raising of Moon Spawn proved to everyone but himself of the power he still has
Rake leaves, his absence feels palpable
High Priestess prays to Mother Dark, that Mother Dark never understood her son, that it was Draconus’s doing

cards.h: Scene 11 (Reach of Woe tavern, Reccanto Ilk)

i.html: Three demonic women are clawing to get into the tavern
Reccanto Ilk’s mouth is bloody, Mappo holds the door as the demons’ claw into his shoulders and back
Gruntle, Faint, and a Bole are at the shuttered side windows
Quell and Precious Thimble are in the back of the room
Glanno Tarp went outside earlier to check on the carriage, Cartographer is still tied to the carriage wheel
On Gruntle’s count, Mappo leaps back and falls onto Faint and the Bole brother
Gruntle decapitates two demons, green blood sprays out
Reccanto Ilk incidentally performs a flawless flèche while pissing his pants, the rapier piercing between the eyes shatters inside the demon’s skull
Sweetest Sufferance and Gruntle are impressed, Reccanto feels like strutting
Precious Thimble feels uncomfortable that the Bole brothers have been paying less attention to her
The Boles volunteer to go find Glanno Tarp
Quell knocks on the cellar door to let the tavernkeep know it’s safe
The three demons were the tavern keep’s cursed daughters. It occurs when they come of age
They’re on the Reach of Woe, judging by his accent it’s on an island in southern Genabackis. A wrecker coast
The provost that they can talk to lives in the tower
Gruntle and the Boles walk to the carriage where they left it in the corral
Glanno was found yapping to himself and saying highly concerning things about girls in his life
Glanno’s arms and legs are broken, doesn’t want to move until Quell comes
Gruntle lifts the carriage, Cartographer is still tied to the wheel completely covered in mud
(Precious Thimble)
The provost lives in a rounded square Jaghut tower
Precious Thimble is upset, she left Blackdog Forest and Mott Wood because of Jaghut
Mappo thinks of Icarium and grunts
Precious thinks it’ll be easier to find the caster of the curse and have them call it off
Quell is worried that Precious, Faint, and Sweetest Sufferance might be cursed while they’re stuck in town to repair the carriage
Quell goes to pee, Precious whispers to the person inside the tower
As the group walks to the tower, the door opens
(Quell)
The provost is named Bedusk Pall Kovuss Agape, called himself a “Jaghut Anap”
Deep blue skinned Jaghut, blue stained tusks with silver caps
Bedusk lost an argument to his wife 9 years, so he cursed her and her friends, women who have not given birth
Precious Thimble recognizes the curse to be Tralka Vonan, blood feeders
Bedusk buried his wife alive in the yard, which collapsed and fell into sea two days ago
Bedusk refuses to lift the curse, the curse will affect the women unless they get pregnant within the next day
Reach of Woe has villagers light false fires, drawing ships to be wrecked on the reefs
People would go out to collect loot from the wrecks and kill any survivors
Loot is dumped in a warehouse in a cave
Justified by attacking pirate raiders before they attack the village
A survivor washes up on shore and walks to the cave
(Precious Thimble)
Precious Thimble knows Quell is having fantasies of having the men impregnating the women, all to have them not be subjected to the curse
Precious thinks the village deserves the curse for being wreckers, Mappo doesn’t disagree
Precious Thimble decides to take Faint and Sweetest Sufferance and wait away from the village until the carriage is fixed
(Gruntle)
Returning to the village, Gruntle tells Quell that Glanno Tarp needs healing
Quell tries to get Precious Thimble to do it, but she can only splint and (magical witch) spit on wounds to disinfect
Gruntle agrees, Precious thinks he’s trying to get at her and leaves
Quell says Gruntle’s mistake is thinking like a man
(Glanno Tarp)
Glanno continues his monologue of very suspect lovers but stops when he sees a figure that arrived from the warehouse loading platform
The horses run away
Gruntle walks with Quell who predicts Glanno will decline his potions and sorceries because it’ll cut into his profits and might even put him in debt after the job
Gruntle and Quell see a Jaghut woman approaching the Boles and Glanno Tarp
The Boles attack, the Jaghut unleashes sorcery that detonates, destroying the corral and casting an actinic blue light
The Boles survive and pin both of the Jaghut’s arms because they hate swamp witches
Gruntle threatens to behead both of them and they let go
The Jaghut is Bedusk’s buried wife that fell into the sea, plans to destroy the whole village
She lets them live because they’re not pirates, wreckers, or necromancers
Bedusk watches from his window and feels he’s in trouble
Kedeviss walks over to Clip and sensed that Clip was no longer himself ever since he woke up
The K’Chain Che’Malle machine was used by Hairlock and Bellurdan Skullcrusher to escape the Abyss

The Dying God claims the machine’s nature in creating gates, traveling through realms, cast a wider net which captured a child god (referring to himself). Does not mention what happened to the Hairlock
The Dying God has been freed, plans to use Nimander’s kin to infiltrate Black Coral and kill Anomander Rake because he deserves it and take his power
However, the Dying God’s real goal is the Redeemer godling
The Dying God grabs Kedeviss by the throat and mouth, forcing kelyk into her body and killing her brain
Kedeviss dies ☠
Aranatha senses Clip had killed Kedeviss, threw her body in a fissure, and faked her footprints to make it appear as an accident
Aranatha tells Nimander to act follow along for now
They both grieve for Kedeviss
Sunrise, Endest is outside the Black Coral’s Night to see Anomander off
Rake calls Endest a friend more than Rake deserves, and that they must take risks in order to live
Rake walks to the tree line, turns around to wave to Endest, then disappears into the forest
Book Four:
Toll the Hounds
Kruppe describes scenes all around Darujhistan, leading up to the ox cart returning with Murillio’s corpse
Kruppe’s rage bleeds into his narration
The ox cart moves through the gates, people moving out of the way to distance themselves from death
The ox carter enters the Phoenix Inn and orders breakfast, before doing business
Crokus doesn’t know if he feels love with Challice
Scillara is better at sex, Challice feels like she’s frantically looking for something she’ll never find
Crokus can see the appeal of being a manwhore like Murillio but doesn’t think it’s for him
Indulges in self-sabotage with Challice
Crokus enters the annex warehouse, the local workers looking at him with envy and jealousy
Challice tells Crokus the situation about Gorlas, he left yesterday, he knows and thinks he’s planning to kill him
Crokus can see Challice feels excited
Challice doesn’t want to actually run away, she only says things in the heat of the moment that she didn’t mean
Crokus says Gorlas won’t kill Challice. They’ll do this over and over together with different lovers because neither of them will be bored
Challice wants Crokus to go to the mines and kill Gorlas and says ‘I love you’
Challice kisses him without letting him talk back
(Narrator Kruppe)
Venaz leads his gang into a tunnel called the Steep
Venaz was sold by his stepfather 4 years ago, his mother was an alcoholic that probably liked the money got more booze
Knowing one is not loved even by the ones that gave birth to them scars them for life with trust issues
Kruppe doesn’t excuse Venaz for his actions, but just to understand the boy and those like him more
(Venaz)
Venaz leads a gang of kids younger than him, knowing the moment he looks weak one of them will try to take his place
Venaz goes up to the three adult men fixing a cart axle, asks them where Bainisk and his moles are
The men don’t care about Gorlas’s duel
Venaz tried to threaten them
The man Haid slaps Venaz to the ground, chokes him until he turns blue
Haid says Gorlas owns them, won’t help give over a boy for him to destroy
Venaz notes their names - Haid, Favo, Dule - and says they’re on his list
Venaz was embarrassed but quickly recovered, the boys missed their opportunity to replace him
(Harllo)
Harllo slides along a silver vein, excited for extra rewards like bigger dinner portions or water wine
Bainisk calls out to Harllo in a panic
Harllo slowly crawls out of the tight space like a caterpillar, Bainisk pulls him out so hard that rocks scrape off hair and skin
Warns that Gorlas killed someone looking for Harllo, and now he’s looking for him
Bainisk leads Harllo further into an unexplored area with icy water ankle deep
Bainisk wants them to escape to Settle, a cliff about to collapse into a lake, and run away together to the city
Harllo is too weak to go on, at Bainisk’s command Harllo drops his lantern and holds Bainisk’s shirt to follow him
Deeper, the icy water rises up to Harllo’s thighs, then his hips, then his chest
Bainisk ties a rope around Harllo and pulls him through a submerged tunnel
Harllo wants to tell him the city isn’t as great as he made it to be
On the other side, Harllo and Bainisk enter an area with, phosphorescent mold, broken pottery and burned bone
Bainisk believes it was where Gadrobi buried their ancestors
The path leads to a cliff with a fissure in the way
Harllo climbs down first then Bainisk follows
Harllo calls out to Bainisk when he reaches the end of the rope, no answer
(Bainisk)
Bainisk looks up to see Venaz and his gang pulling the rope up
Bainisk cuts the rope with his knife
Fisher and Duiker speak at a table
Blend watches Scillara smoking, thinks of comatose Picker upstairs
Blend hates that she wants to move on to someone new already
Antsy can’t decide how many weapons to take
Has crossbows, shortswords, axes, a broadsword, a buckler, rapiers tangled in each other’s quillons, a sack of three sharpers
Fisher has told them the contract on them was bought out and canceled
Antsy doesn’t believe he’s the famous Fisher kel Tarth who has poems a hundred years’ old
Duiker says the poet is immortal, unsure if that’s literal or metaphorical
Duiker reassures Blend that he’ll start to look after Picker
Blend, Scillara, and Antsy head out through the bustling Daru District to the Warden Barracks
The guard asks if they’re visiting, Antsy jokes they’re here to break someone out
Antsy gets belligerent and then arrested for 3 days with 3 drunks and an insane masked man
Blend and Scillara visit Barathol
Blend can pay Barathol’s fines, but his fight sentenced him to six months of labor that also counts as a rehab program for Eldra Foundry
When Barathol is finished, he’ll earn a ticket as a smith. No limit to how fast you can advance as long as you pass the exams
(Baruk)
Baruk comes to the Temple of Shadow
A bhokaral opens the door and runs further inside, Baruk walks in
Mogora, whom he recognizes as a witch of Ardata, curses him
Baruk demands she retract the curse before he loses his temper, Mogora disappears into a heap of spiders
Sordiko Qualm finds Baruk and beckons to follow
(Iskaral)
Iskaral sits on the floor of all altar chamber sharpening knives to kill the bhokarala
Baruk and Sordiko come
Sordiko admits to a crisis of faith and looks ready to cry
Iskaral delivers Shadowthrone’s message, “to set a watch over a gate”
Proceeds to name all of Darujhistan’s gates turn says it must be Urs Gate
The bhokarala come in and steals all the knives
Lady Spite takes care of Chaur while Barathol is under arrest
Believes a High Denul healer can do a lot for Chaur’s mind that’s just made of impulses and confusion
Despite that, he’s mostly happy and she might not want to ruin that
Talks about her sister Envy, describes her as a vicious, ice cold, treacherous, and murder kin
Her immunity to unhappiness is proof of her insanity
Spite cleans up Chaur, needs to leave him on the ship so she can go into the city and talk to Envy
Someone noticed a wrapped corpse outside and told Meese, who went to pull the covers and found Murillio
The Phoenix Inn is in mourning, Meese and Irilta carried his body upstairs
Word sent to Coll
The ox carter explained what he knew, Kruppe figured the boy he dueled for is Stonny’s missing son Harllo
Two men head to the Phoenix Inn, if Rallick arrived first then things would be much different than how events would happen
Instead, Crokus arrives at the Phoenix Inn before Rallick does
Crokus passes the ox carter, sees Meese heavily drinking
Kruppe sits at his table, facing the wall with back turned to the bar, four empty cups with the most expensive wine bottle
Kruppe tells Crokus that Murillio was killed in a duel by Gorlas Vidikas trying to retrieve Harllo
Crokus thinks Gorlas already one everything about him, that Gorlas did this to hurt him
Crokus leaves. Kruppe tries to get him to wait for Rallick and Coll
Meese tells him to get Gorlas
Narrator Kruppe transitions to another scene
Bellam carries Hinty and uses rope as a handhold to lead Mew to Stonny’s dueling school
Bellam tells her that Murillio found Harllo at the mining camp, but hasn’t come back yet
Bellam chastises her to take responsibility and take care of Bedek and Myrla’s children, just as they had for Stonny’s child
Bellam goes home to let his parents know he’s okay and then will go find Murillio
Stonny holds a crying Mew
Bellam’s blunt honesty did what Gruntle couldn’t, blast open her soul and refill it
Shardan Lim waits for Challice at her home
Feels discarded, knows Challice has been sleeping with a lowborn thief and insinuates more
Shardan rapes Challice and leaves confused when she thanks him
Challice thinks of her glass globe with the trapped moon, of her lost youth
Coll arrives and hates the old dueling laws, wants to outlaw duels before the city council
Rallick arrives, Irilta cries in his arms and tells him what happened
Sulty and the new cook Chud stand by the kitchen door
Both Coll and Rallick drinks the wine
Kruppe purposely choose less potent but heavily spiced wine anticipating Coll’s alcoholic relapse
Kruppe says Crokus already left, Crokus earned his new name Cutter with he proved when he nearly killed Rallick
Kruppe snaps at them in a tone they never heard before
Coll is pissed at the week wine and tells Kruppe to piss off
Rallick backhands Coll, Coll reaches for his knife
Meese smashes the wine bottle on the ground, says they need to post respects and walk Murillio’s corpse to the crypt
Kruppe puts his hand on Coll’s shoulder, Coll breaks down, Rallick weeps in his hands

Survivors do not mourn together. They each mourn alone, even when in the same place. Grief is the most solitary of all feelings. Grief isolates, and every ritual, every gesture, every embrace, is a hopeless effort through that isolation.
None of it works. The forms crumble and dissolve.
To face death is to stand alone.
Picker walks through a frozen realm, naked with fingers and toes black and frostbitten
Togg and Fanderay follow her, Picker thinks it’s because Treach marked her with the torcs
Picker goes through a forest of dark spruce, her fingers and toes break off
Down a mountain pass to a valley below, leading into a verdant warm jungle
Her hands and feet are whole again
Picker hears a cat’s cough and flees
Encounters mounds of corroded and rusted swords of all styles
Picker keeps running, trips and falls down into green high grasses
A group of five female and four male, shorter humanoids wielding spears, try to fend off a leopard nearby
The humanoids look at Picker then take her prisoner
They lead her on a trail to a cave mouth with two old women surrounded by quier children
Picker believes the humanoids are prey in this world
Picker is forced into a sloped, low ceiling cave tunnel
The humanoids shove her with the spears
Picker falls into greasy floor, the floor disappears and she falls
Harllo falls onto sharp boulders at the bottom of the fissure
His back and leg are cut, but no bones broken
Harllo crawls over to where Bainisk fell and rested good head on his lap
Harllo felt Bainisk’s shattered skull and half ruined face
Bainisk asks to tell him about the city

Harllo describes the most idyllic city he could think of, but also of mothers that loves their son, fathers that don’t rape, that they’d love you if you worked hard enough not to be a burden and if they didn’t then you have to work harder
Bainisk dies ☠
Nightfall on Darujhistan, blue flame lamps are lit
Murillio is interred in a crypt
Lady Envy goes to find her sister
Scorch and Leff stand duty.
Torvald paces in the compound.
Madrun and Lazan throw knuckles at the wall
Studlock watches from the balcony above
Challice sits in her bedroom holding the moon globe
Blend cries over Picker’s body
Duiker watches Fisher begin to play a song
Irilta crawls into her bed, mourning Murillio who she never confessed her love to, and commits suicide by slashing hers wrists lengthwise
Bellam Nom leaves through Two Ox Gate to look for Murillio
Crokus stole a horse and rides to the Eldra Mines
In his mind, he sees Apsalar trying to persuade him away but he persists
The soul knows no greater anguish than to take a breath that begins with love and end with grief
The last breath is not meant for lovers or dreamers. For the one standing alone in the dark
Nimander’s kin mourns the death of Kedeviss
The group feels distant from Nimander because he shows no emotion to her death
Skintick wanted to climb down and bury her body, a very human notion. Tiste Andii don’t care for corpses, without Mother Dark their souls wander forever lost
Ninander wonders if the Dying God is a real threat to the Tiste Andii
Unlike humans, Tiste Andii don’t value blind obedience. People must earn the privilege to be followed
Titles or ranks has no inherent value
Nimander is reminded of the Bonehunters, how many officers were incompetent and the informal justice system of backstabbing weeded them out
Nimander wonders if saemenkelyk will make the Tiste Andii vulnerable
Skintick sees the waters of the Cut, Black Coral is on its northern shore
Clip wants to continue on before it gets too dark
Skintick notes the trail is dangerous especially when it’s getting dark and they night slip
They are reminded of Kedeviss and get quiet, Clip continues on
The rest of the group confront Nimander, they already suspect Clip killed Kedeviss
Desra noticed that Clip’s different, ignores Skintick’s insults about her
Skintick doesn’t feel confident relying on Anomander Rake to deal with Clip, especially not knowing anything about Black Coral
Nimander tells them to keep playing dumb and unwittingly asserts his leadership
Nenanda asks Skintick how Nimander takes the lead
Skintick believes Nimander still is full of doubts, but they follow him because he has resolve. He doesn’t fear the doubts he has and that humbles them
Monkrat watches new pilgrims visiting the Great Barrow, those that drank kelyk
Recalls Salind’s words ‘No believer should arrive willing’, ‘don’t trust an easy believer’
The ex-Bridgeburner Spindle recognizes Monkrat’s face and holds a knife to his throat, confronting a deserter
Monkrat recognizes the smell of Spindle’s hairshirt
Monkrat explains all his friends died in Blackdog Swamp, didn’t want to stay just to die in Coral. Surprised to see Spindle not in uniform
Spindle explains Dujek let the survivors with death and retire in Darujhistan
Spindle came from Darujhistan to Black Coral and visit Itkovian’s barrow since he had seen the man in person before, left a sharper when he was first buried
Spindle, Antsy, Bluepearl, Picker, Blend, Paran, and Duiker
If the Redeemer fell to the Dying God’s kelyk, Monkrat expects Silanah to come burn everything to the ground and Rake to kill the godling
Monkrat takes Spindle to Black Coral to look at Silanah, same dragon that razed Blackdog Swamp
It begins to rain
The emanation/“voice of outrage” is significant enough to make ripples in the bowls of water around High Priestess
She does not feel ready
Ponders on her own role as High Priestess of a goddess that rejects her very being. She does not have wisdom, but persistence in futility
As a High Priestess with no goddess, she is free to make up whatever she wants
Lies can be hidden when only she speaks, but when people can talk back then her lies and weak conviction can be exposed
The starving, the warriors facing death, the greed of kings, all don’t have luxury to spare for such discussion against a priestess.
High Priestess wonders how Rake would respond to gods/goddesses being different from kings
Rake would break down the necessity of every single action of Mother Dark, even her turning away
High Priestess realizes Rake’s betrayal of Mother Dark was necessary
The temple historian enters and asks if they are at war
High Priestess affirms they are at war on many fronts, it is the most dangerous times since Kharkanas
The one war front concerning the priestesses may not need drawing weapons
Spinnock Durav and Anomander Rake both must face their own war front and succeed, if one fails all fails
High Priestess he won’t summon Feral from her tower
The temple historian believes it's her duty to scribe, High Priestess prefers she’d rather spend the end of the world finding a man and making love
Seerdomin asks the Redeemer about redemption, Itkovian has no answer to give him
Seerdomin wonders if Salind serves the Crippled God
Itkovian tries to explain the difference between the Crippled God and the Dying God
For the Crippled God, flaw is a virtue. Worshipers suffer until they die and obtain salvation. They do not seek to have a perfect soul. There is no blessing

For the Dying God, the blessing is giving up independent thought and sense of self. If worshipers only see that their life is doomed to fail and their choices meaningless, then the failure itself is worship. The act of dying is enslavement, worship where all choice is taken from them. How it can heal the soul, there is no answer yet
Seerdomin worries what eternal dying does to redemption
Kelyk begins to rain down, Salind raises her head and looks to Seerdomin
Kallor sees the Gadrobi Hills and Darujhistan to the northern horizons
Kallor would sit on the throne in the Temple of the Chains
Munug would be there, High Priest of Pathos, Prophet of Failure
Kallor is ready to make this the seat of a new immortal empire
The other gods joined together and will likely destroy the Crippled God. The worshipers lose their god, leaving them open for Kallor to take
The Crippled God won’t make it easy, misery and suffering exists as long as humanity exists
Kallor won’t wait and will take the throne, even willing to negotiate with the gods as long as he gets the throne
Samar Dev looks across at standing stones raised ages ago that reaches about half a mile
Traveller reaches on of the phallic menhirs to wait for Samar
Samar is irritated because she feels like she’s slowing Traveller and Karsa down, both driven by motivation which she lacks
Samar misses her horse that Tulas Shorn had stolen and set free, a simple beast pleased by care and affection
Samar is exhausted climbing the slope
At the top of the slope, Karsa rides Havok and looks down at Samar Dev asking why not just ride on Havok
Samar pulls herself up to the top, leans on her on standing stone, and noticed carvings around quartz nodules
Samar ponders on how much ancient history is lost and does her best to trace the carvings to keep its history alive
Karsa reflects on his travels, where every cruelty was the same encourages he went, different shades of the same color
Thinks about the Letherii empire, the Tiste Edur emperor, how the Crippled God wanted Karsa to take the cursed sword, lead the Teblor, and be the living embodiment of suffering
The Crippled God did not understand the simple truth that Karsa could not be broken.
Samar did not understand Karsa’s desire to reshape the world, called him stubborn and stupid
Karsa tells Samar he understands why she does not want to ride Havok, because she sees it as surrender and wants to control her own pace
Samar doesn’t understand how much control she has at all, doesn’t know why gods of war are visiting her
Karsa asks why she became a witch that communicates with spirits
Samar was just curious and wanted to pursue knowledge and patterns, finds pleasure discovering things
Samar asks why the bear visited her, Karsa says its because of the upcoming war, Traveller ignores the questions
Samar gets frustrated with the secrecy
Karsa once again offers Havok and that she sacrifices nothing, she gets on the horse
Samar wonders why Traveller has changed, Karsa says shadows are cruel
Ditch watches Draconus strangle Kadaspala
Kadaspala tried to create a child god with his tattoos, using Ditch as the nexus brain
Draconus only wants the pattern to defy Chaos. Dragnipur is meant to keep Darkness in and Chaos out
Ditch believes every soul started with a word
Kadaspala tattooed the word ‘kill’ on Ditch
Precious Thimble looks at the stars, as the Trygalle carriage returns
Mappo, Gruntle, Glanno Tarp, Reccanto Ilk, the Boles, Cartographer, Master Quell
Faint wakes Sweetest Sufferance up
Bedusk continues to argue with his wife, the danger zone extending to the rest of the cliff island
Sweetest Sufferance jokes if the girls feel bloodthirsty [Note: from the bloodthirsty curse], she laughs as no one answers
Cartographer draws a mark in the dirt that needs magical investiture to fully slow their path they should take
Cartographer holds up rope and asked to be tied to a wheel
Midnight
Kallor approaches Darujhistan from the southwestern end of the Gadrobi Hills
Samar Dev, Karsa Orlong, and the Traveller are 9 miles west of Kallor
The Hounds of Shadow are 3 miles north of the trio, a Hound howls as the city bell strikes midnight
The stars spark above, Kallor’s blood runs cold and he feels scared
Havok suddenly pulls and skitters, Samar had to hold on tight to Karsa, feeling his muscles
The Traveller reacts to the Hound’s howling and tries to brush it off
Chillbais sits on the corner gate and hears the Hound’s howl
Midnight strikes, one last day for the Gedderone’s fete new year celebration period
(Narrator Kruppe)
Sunrise, Crokus has reached the Eldra Mines
(Gorlas Vidikas)
Gorlas is surprised another person came for Harllo
Expects Coll came for revenge and is excited to kill him to open up a council seat and kill a second conspirator involving Lady Simtal’s and Turban Orr’s deaths
Walks up a set of stairs, has a vision of a corpse hanging and twisting under a tree
Gorlas sees Crokus, thinks Challice sent him
Crokus says he’s here for Murillio and the boy
Gorlas says the boy is dead
The foreman calls for a rapier, a boy delivers a rusted blade with an unwrapped hilt
Crokus baits Gorlas, saying his wife calls him “Useless”
Gorlas dispenses with convention
(The foreman)
The foreman prepares to watch the duel
He blinks and misses Crokus throwing two daggers into Gorlas’ chest.
Gorlas dies ☠
Crokus speaks with the foreman, gets him to agree with what transpired to report to his boss [Humble Measure]
Gorlas dispensed with convention and Crokus never voiced a formal challenge
The foreman affirms Harllo died and asks who the boy is
Crokus doesn’t even know himself, but from what he could tell Harllo was a boy no one loved
Crokus rides away on his horse
The foreman calls for three guards and horses for them
(Crokus)
Crokus rides until nightfall, then stops and weeps in his hands
The three riders move past Crokus
The water of the Settle drained, making it easier for Venaz to follow Bainisk and Harllo
Removes Bainisk’s rope, replaces it with his own, ties a lantern hanging below him, and Venaz climbs down the fissure. The lantern hitting rocks first letting him know its safe to stand
Venaz finds Bainisk’s corpse. Bainisk’s bag of belongings, his rope, and Harllo are missing
It is not solid ground, rather the fissure is plugged by loose rocks that could collapse any moment, warm air rising between the cracks
15 steps away, the plug becomes a sheer drop. Venaz climbs along the edge to the other side of the crevasse and finds another fissure

Venaz climbs into the fissure, scraping his body, having to exhale to be thinner. Climbs about 10 feet until the fissure widens again and reaches a perpendicular fissure. Forest detritus and scents of the lake shore
Venaz continues to crawl, the fissure leading to an upward slope, sees Harllo near the top
Venaz sings Harllo’s name and crawls up the slope
Harllo climbs out of the fissure
(Narrator Kruppe)
Something arrives, shadowy shapes move about
(Thordy)
Thordy watches Gaz leave their home, steps outside to her pavestone circle, looks up to see there’s no moon in the night sky
Thordy hears a voice in her head speaking about the legacy of death, calming her
Thordy slashes her wrist with a kitchen knife
Tiserra washes her hands as she feels something bad is going to happen
Tiserra opens up Torvald’s cache and finds the Blue Moranth munitions missing
Believes Torvald’s greatest talent is surviving, can only hope that he’s safe
Blend walks down to the taproom
Fisher tunes his instrument, Duiker looks at his drink
Scillara left hours ago, both Antsy and Barathol are in jail, Picker is upstairs
Blend leaves
Chaur holds onto the spear the Soldier of Death had left behind

[Note: The Soldier of Death, an undead Seguleh, appears via warren when Crokus’ group was at a Temple of D’rek. The Soldier believes Hood sent him to meet a ‘son of Darujhistan’ and blood relative of a council member]
Chaur misses Barathol, drops the spear and leaves the ship to find him

cards.h: Scene 11 (Near Lady Envy’s estate, Lady Spite)

i.html: Lady Spite taps her lips, standing across the street from Lady Envy’s estate
The Hound of Shadows’ howl is heard, Spite wonders how it’ll change things
The guard investigating the murders by Gaz walks along the wall bordering the Lakefront District and Daru District
Feels a dull ache in his chest that shoots down his left arm
The guard’s request for a necromancer’s aid was denied by the city
Finds it strangely quiet for the last night of Gedderone’s Fete
Hears a storm south of the city
The guard feels chest pain as he remembers kissing his wife and hugging his kids before leaving for work
Rallick, Coll, Meese, and Kruppe return from interring Murillio’s body into a crypt
Rallick leaves
Seba gathers his 31 assassins and splits them into 3 groups
Expects a councilor to be dead in the morning
Shardan Lim comes to the Vidikas Estate
Planned to usurp House Vidikas by impregnating Challice’s first child
Proud of being pure Daru, thinks Gadrobi heritage among nobles is an embarrassment
The foreman’s three riders arrive to deliver message Gorlas’ death to Challice and Humble Measure
One of the rider’s believes it was an assassination, had seen two knives sticking out of Gorlas
Shardan has them also deliver the message to Hanut Orr and pays for their lodging
Shardan thinks cousins or half-relations will try to claim inheritance on House Vidikas and needs to work fast with Challice to secure their position
Shardan hears the storm’s thunder to the south
Challice walks out wearing a sheer gown that shows her body to meet Shardan
Walks past the house staff, thinking luck and mischance are the only factors to success. Talent, skill, and cunning are lies people tell themselves
